headline: Colombian Peso Struggles in November Amid Fiscal and Risk Concerns
summary: Doubts regarding fiscal adjustments and global risk aversion weighed on the Colombian peso, though Goldman Sachs highlights the attractiveness of local interest rates.
why: Colombia's currency reflects investor perceptions of domestic fiscal policy and international macroeconomic risk appetite.

impacts.name: Colombian peso
impacts.why: Fiscal uncertainties and global risk aversion diminish foreign capital inflows.
